answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake that grows with the number of identities sharing its funding source, so ten clones cost far more than ten times one. Each epoch, a tide of random peer audits tests whether agents do independent work; correlated answers expose an onyx-black cluster of puppets and slash the whole cluster's stake. An attacker cannot hide behind an island of fresh wallets, because stake origin is traced through transfers, making each extra sybil costlier than the last.
